meta_description:
4,465 likes, 19 comments - siddharthajoshi on September 13, 2026: "Why does the iPhone Duo costs so much in India? 

Before assuming it’s just a markup, and possibly some of it is, but frankly most of it comes from the factors below:

- US Base Price: $1,999 pre-tax ➔ ~$2,15,000 post-tax in the US.

- Local Assembly Savings: Apple makes standard iPhones locally in India to save ~17% import duty.

- The CBU Reality: The iPhone Duo’s complex precision engineering (100+ hinge components, new PCB, custom display) requires new assembly tech that isn’t in India yet. 
 
- Taxes & Logistics: Importing it fully built (CBU) triggers heavy Import Duties + 18% GST + Forex buffers, driving up the cost by ₹60,000–₹70,000.

Once local assembly kicks in for future generations, expect those heavy import duties to drop! Or will they?

Drop your thoughts in the comments! 👇

#iphoneduo #iphone #appleevent".
